_comment: Contents of the two system trays on the bottom panel, in panel order.
bottom-panel.nix declares the two bare org.kde.plasma.systemtray widgets;
this file says what goes in them. plasma-systray-config.sh applies it.
Tray 1 = our own daemons only (ids published by da_my-konsole's
There is deliberately no 'hidden' list: hiddenItems is computed as the
complement of 'shown', because the systray default for an id it was never
told about is *shown*. Listing hidden items only hides what we predicted,
which is how my-ai-usage / Xwayland Video Bridge / diskquota leaked in.
